These support an intrinsic act/perfection intuition, NOT the stronger claim that concrete existence cannot modally entail a deficiency. Rejected bridge: actuality-as-such does not intrinsically impose restriction THEREFORE concrete existence is nonlimiting under all modal entailments. Even if every possible actual concretum were contingent, boxed concrete-existence-to-possible-absence inclusion would hold without actuality itself being the explanatory source of restriction. A general bridge from modal implication to intrinsic deficiency attribution, or independently established possibility of an unrestricted concrete actuality, would be additional work; neither read source supplies it. Using the already divine/subsistent-esse application to establish this pre-God premise would reuse the sought foundation rather than independently defend it. Possible-absence limitation also remains evaluative: A8P3 reports a question/answer commitment, while the Aquinas passages do not identify accessible absence with a deficient actualizing mode or establish that every finite being lacks a perfection owed to it. A stronger/modal-deficiency norm could be defended, but was not proved by this audit. Strongest principled rival positions: retain the formal modal reading/closure and reject STMT-CONCRETE-EXISTENCE-IS-NONLIMITING-AT, accepting that actuality can be positive while all its possible concrete instances are limited; or retain only intrinsic/relevance-sensitive nonlimitation and reject STMT-LIMITATION-BACKWARD-CLOSED-AT for mere boxed inclusion, explicitly changing the relation rather than silently borrowing A8 modal closure. A rival may instead dispute STMT-POSSIBLE-ABSENCE-IS-LIMITING-AT by requiring an independently justified deficiency standard. None of these local objections establishes an all-contingent worldview as an adequate explanation of selected actual existence, and no infinite regress is credited with global explanatory success. No new model is needed for the distinction. Unconditional entitlement of BOTH specialized premises remains OPEN, not refuted merely because unproved.
